title: Season weights flip a batting average
hook: Two stated cases: explore at-bat weights across seasons.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How at-bat weights across seasons affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Gap, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare at-bat weights across seasons in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
